title: Consultor de vendas
description:
A PORMADE PORTAS DE MADEIRAS DECORATIVAS, líder no mercado de fabricação e comercialização de portas de madeira, está em busca de um Consultor de Vendas para fazer parte do nosso time.


Há 21 anos, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil e na América Latina, segundo o Great Place to Work, sendo eleita a melhor empresa para se trabalhar no Paraná..


Auxiliamos nossos mais de 1.300 colaboradores a alcançarem o seu potencial máximo, para tornar não só o ambiente de trabalho, mas a sociedade, em um lugar melhor para se viver!


Em constante crescimento e evolução, abrimos uma vaga para:

Consultor de Vendas (Porto Alegre - RS).


Você profissional que goste de interagir e trabalhar com a construção civil, que seja pró-ativo, possua habilidades com negociação e venda consultiva e tenha interesse em não apenas saber vender como também se preocupa com a experiência do cliente, esta oportunidade é para você!


REQUISITOS:

- Experiência prévia na área de construção civil será considerado um diferencial;

- Habilidades de comunicação e negociação;

- Habilidade com informática básica;

- Capacidade de identificar oportunidades de vendas e gerar mais negócios;

- Organização e senso de responsabilidade para gerenciar sua própria carteira de clientes;

- Capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe e colaborar com outros departamentos.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:


- Prestar atendimento consultivo a campo para clientes e parceiros;

- Apresentação de nossos produtos e serviços;

- Vendas com base em visitas em obras;

- Gerenciamento de carteira, conferência de atividades do sistema (CRM);

- Contato e relacionamento com canais de prospecção com a finalidade de manutenção e um funil de vendas saudável.


ALGUNS BENEFÍCIOS E FACILIDADES PARA VOCÊ PODER NOS ACOMPANHAR NA JORNADA COM A GENTE

* Salário compatível com o mercado

* Variável por entrega

* Vale refeição

* Vale alimentação

* Plano de saúde

* Seguro de vida


Se você possui o perfil descrito acima e está em busca de um desafio profissional em uma empresa sólida que está em constante crescimento, candidate-se agora mesmo! Venha fazer parte dos Pormadeanos!

title: Desenvolvedor Android Sênior
description:
A Viajou  nasceu para resolver um problema que todo viajante já enfrentou: a confusão de organizar uma viagem do início ao fim. Nosso app reúne tecnologia, conteúdo e serviços de agência em uma única plataforma, oferecendo pacotes personalizados, suporte humano e integração total para que o usuário apenas curta a viagem. Estamos construindo o futuro das viagens digitais e buscamos pessoas criativas e inovadoras para fazer parte dessa jornada.


✨ O que você fará no dia a dia :

  • Desenvolver e evoluir o aplicativo da Viajou para Android , criando soluções que facilitem o planejamento, a compra e a organização de viagens;
  • Construir funcionalidades escaláveis e sustentáveis, preparados para atender milhares de viajantes;
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, qualidade de código e arquitetura escalável;
  • Colaborar com o time no desenho de soluções técnicas e definição de estratégias de produto;
  • Contribuir para um ambiente de equipe colaborativo, inovador e com troca constante de conhecimento.


 Responsabilidade :

Dar continuidade ao desenvolvimento do aplicativo Viajou para Android, baseado na documentação, wireframes do figma e alinhamento com time de desenvolvimento.


 Requisitos :

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Kotlin
  • Jetpack Compose
  • Design Patterns
  • Arquitetura MVVM
  • Android Architecture Components (Databinding, Lifecycle, LiveData, Room)
  • Conhecimento em RESTful API
  • Conhecimento de SOLID, MVC, Clean Code e Design Patterns ;

    • Seria bom saber:

    • Firebase, Google Maps, In-app purchase, Calendário e Push Notifications
    • Implementação e manutenção de aplicativo de larga escala, injeção de dependências, estruturas de dados e algoritmos;
    • Mentalidade ágil, com vivência em Scrum e Kanban .


     Diferenciais :

    • Participou do início ao fim da implementação de um aplicativo
    • Vivência em planejamento e execução de aplicações em larga escala.


     O que oferecemos ?

    • 100% remoto com horário flexível

A Viajou  nasceu para resolver um problema que todo viajante já enfrentou: a confusão de organizar uma viagem do início ao fim. Nosso app reúne tecnologia, conteúdo e serviços de agência em uma única plataforma, oferecendo pacotes personalizados, suporte humano e integração total para que o usuário apenas curta a viagem. Estamos construindo o futuro das viagens digitais e buscamos pessoas criativas e inovadoras para fazer parte dessa jornada.


✨ O que você fará no dia a dia :

  • Desenvolver e evoluir o aplicativo da Viajou para Android , criando soluções que facilitem o planejamento, a compra e a organização de viagens;
  • Construir funcionalidades escaláveis e sustentáveis, preparados para atender milhares de viajantes;
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, qualidade de código e arquitetura escalável;
  • Colaborar com o time no desenho de soluções técnicas e definição de estratégias de produto;
  • Contribuir para um ambiente de equipe colaborativo, inovador e com troca constante de conhecimento.


 Responsabilidade :

Dar continuidade ao desenvolvimento do aplicativo Viajou para Android, baseado na documentação, wireframes do figma e alinhamento com time de desenvolvimento.


 Requisitos :

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Kotlin
  • Jetpack Compose
  • Design Patterns
  • Arquitetura MVVM
  • Android Architecture Components (Databinding, Lifecycle, LiveData, Room)
  • Conhecimento em RESTful API
  • Conhecimento de SOLID, MVC, Clean Code e Design Patterns ;

    • Seria bom saber:

    • Firebase, Google Maps, In-app purchase, Calendário e Push Notifications
    • Implementação e manutenção de aplicativo de larga escala, injeção de dependências, estruturas de dados e algoritmos;
    • Mentalidade ágil, com vivência em Scrum e Kanban .


     Diferenciais :

    • Participou do início ao fim da implementação de um aplicativo
    • Vivência em planejamento e execução de aplicações em larga escala.


     O que oferecemos ?

    • 100% remoto com horário flexível

title: Microsoft MAUI Developer
description:
Job Description — Microsoft MAUI Developer

Developros is partnering with a U.S. technology team to add a Microsoft MAUI Developer who can contribute to a modern cross-platform application used by thousands of customers. This role is ideal for a self-managing engineer with strong communication skills and a product mindset. You’ll work in real time with a U.S. team, shaping both the technical direction and the user experience.


Role Overview

You will design, build, and maintain cross-platform mobile/desktop applications using .NET MAUI. The ideal candidate brings strong fundamentals in C#, architectural thinking, and an ability to collaborate closely with product and design. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and naturally contributes to team alignment and momentum.


Key Responsibilities
  • Develop high-quality mobile and desktop applications using .NET MAUI.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams in real time (EST/PST overlap).
  • Implement clean architecture, maintainable code, and scalable patterns.
  • Integrate REST APIs, authentication flows, and cloud services (Azure preferred).
  • Build UI components with a focus on performance, accessibility, and user experience.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, optimize performance, and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Participate in code reviews, sprint rituals, and product planning discussions.


Required Skills & Experience
  • 3+ years of experience with C#/.NET development.
  • Hands-on experience with MAUI, Xamarin, or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of MVVM patterns and reactive architectures.
  • Experience integrating APIs and working with cloud platforms (Azure is a plus).
  • Solid understanding of mobile/desktop lifecycle, memory management, and performance optimization.
  • Comfortable working in agile environments and collaborating directly with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Strong English communication, emotional intelligence, and proactive ownership.


Nice to Have
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Background in UI/UX collaboration or component design.
  • Experience with push notifications, offline sync, or advanced mobile capabilities.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools and instrumentation.


What Makes This Opportunity Unique
  • Joining through Developros means working with a partner that prioritizes team chemistry, long-term alignment, and human-centered collaboration . Our developers operate as trusted extensions of U.S. teams — not outsourced executors. You’ll work with leaders who value initiative, clarity, and craftsmanship.

title: Advogado Tributário Pleno (R$4.000)
description:
Advogado Tributário Pleno (R$4.000)


Oportunidade de Crescimento de Carreira para Advogado Tributarista


Qualificações:


  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em contencioso tributário (judicial e administrativo) em escritório de advocacia;
  • 2 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em consultoria tributária (desejável);
  • Experiência em Big Four (diferencial);
  • Pós-graduação de Direito Tributário (diferencial);
  • Inscrição ativa na OAB.


Principais Atividades:


  • Atuar em demandas judiciais e administrativas tributárias e fiscais;
  • Analisar publicações e controlar seus respectivos prazos;
  • Prestar atendimento eficiente aos clientes, garantindo uma comunicação clara e transparente;
  • Realizar pesquisas jurídicas abrangentes para embasar estratégias de defesa;
  • Colaborar com colegas de equipe para desenvolver e implementar estratégias jurídicas eficazes;
  • Atuar na consultoria tributária envolvendo Tributos Diretos e Indiretos;
  • Elaborar respostas a consultas e memorandos sobre temas variados ligados ao Direito Tributário;
  • Avaliar regimes tributários especiais e benefícios fiscais aplicáveis;
  • Planejamento tributário estratégico, incluindo reorganizações societárias.


Sobre o Santos Varella Advocacia


  • O Santos Varella é um escritório de advocacia especializado em Direito Tributário. Com equipe de profissionais gabaritados com mais de 15 anos de excelência no mercado, atuamos na consultoria e no contencioso. Nosso diferencial está na vasta experiência de nossos profissionais, cujo histórico abrange setores jurídicos e tributários de grandes empresas multinacionais, escritórios renomados e gigantes da consultoria.

title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: Analista GIS
description:
Este profissional terá como responsabilidades o desenvolvimento de soluções e a manutenção de soluções Geoespaciais em plataforma ArcGIS, levantamento de requisitos e a elaboração de propostas de soluções no sistema ArcGIS. Trabalhamos em um ambiente altamente colaborativo e que permite o desenvolvimento individual de nossos colaboradores.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Superior Completo em Engenharias ou TI e/ou Pós-graduação Completa em Engenharia ou TI.
  • Experiência comprovada na área.


Competências GEO e ArcCGIS:

  • Conhecimento de SIG;
  • Conhecimento do ArcGIS Online, APPs, Enterprise;
  • Conhecimento de automatização de processos usando Python.


Tipos de Dados SIG:

  • Gerenciamento e armazenamento de dados SIG;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de coordenadas;
  • Conhecimento de obtençào de dados SIG;
  • Criação de mapas e visualização;
  • Análises espaciais básicas;
  • Conhecimento no sistema ArcGIS.


Conhecimentos desejáveis:

  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de demandas;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções usando as ferramentas disponíveis no Sistema ArcGIS. Desenvolver scripts Python para integração à plataforma ArcGIS.
  • Desenvolver atividades técnicas de gestão e produção de dados geoespaciais e alfanuméricos.
  • Interpretar documentos de especificação técnica de componentes e requisitos das soluções seja serviços ou produtos.
  • Prestar apoio no planejamento dos projetos no tratamento e gerenciamento de dados geoespaciais e alfanuméricos, realizando o levantamento de informações técnicas e analisando os insumos necessários com base em aspectos qualitativos e quantitativos.
  • Analisar e gerar documentos de especificação técnica de componentes e requisitos das soluções seja serviços ou produtos. Implementar soluções usando as ferramentas disponíveis no Sistema ArcGIS.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.


We’re looking for a Senior Front-End Developer with a strong foundation in modern web technologies to help us craft performant, scalable, and user-centric digital experiences. You’ll play a key role in building and maintaining a hybrid SSR-enabled front-end architecture powered by React or Next.js, while collaborating cross-functionally with design, product, and backend teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain responsive, device-optimized user interfaces using React or Next.js, leveraging SSR/SSG for performance and SEO.
  • Integrate with a headless CMS (Contentful, Strapi, or Sanity) to support localization and rapid content iterations.
  • Build and extend reusable front-end component libraries using Storybook (or similar) to ensure consistent design implementation.
  • Collaborate with designers in Figma to translate design systems into robust, maintainable UI components.
  • Work with the API Gateway / BFF (Backend for Frontend) layer to consume and aggregate APIs for multi-channel delivery, including integrating with Drupal APIs.
  • Style components using Tailwind CSS and maintain scalable, accessible CSS organization.
  • Optimize build and deployment pipelines using Vite for fast, modern front-end delivery.
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and accessibility across the stack.


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in front-end development building production-grade applications.
  • Strong proficiency with React or Next.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience working with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Strapi, or Sanity).
  • Proficiency in modern styling tools like Tailwind CSS.
  • Familiarity with API gateways or BFF patterns for decoupled front-ends.
  • Experience integrating with external systems (e.g., Drupal via REST or GraphQL APIs).
  • Solid understanding of UX/UI design principles and ability to work closely with design teams using Figma.
  • Hands-on experience in performance optimization, accessibility, and testing.


Nice to Have

  • Experience creating or maintaining internal design systems.
  • Knowledge of Storybook, Vite, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Passion for emerging front-end trends and developer experience improvements.


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape an evolving, modern front-end architecture.
  • Collaborative and forward-thinking environment with design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Flexible work arrangements and emphasis on professional growth.

description:

title: Analista de Testes Automatizados Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

No papel de Test Automation Engineer, a pessoa Builder trabalhará em equipes para fornecer soluções robustas e escaláveis para automação de processos de qualidade de software. Deverá desenvolver e executar testes automatizados para aplicações em multiplataformas, assim como, criar e manter uma sólida gestão de testes por meio de melhores práticas.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência com testes automatizados nas 3 camadas: API, Web e Mobile
  • Ruby
  • Capybara
  • HTTParty
  • Python
  • Robot Framework
  • Locust
  • Postman
  • BDD


Você irá se destacar se:

  • Experiência em testes cross-platform usando BrowserStack, SauceLabs, AWS Device Farm etc;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gerenciamento de testes (Qase, Zephyr, XRay, etc).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Ficou com curiosidade de saber mais? #SóBora se inscrever?

title: Javascript React Developer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Frontend React Developer, you will contribute to the team's user experience, application performance, and front-end architecture. This requires applying strong debugging and problem-solving skills to technical challenges and maintaining clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role is responsible for promoting secure coding practices, delivering high-quality solutions, and helping to shape team standards. You will utilize cloud platform capabilities, particularly AWS, while working independently to manage priorities and collaborating with backend, DevOps, and architecture teams to support the team's commitment to continuous improvement.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Work in a dynamic team to provide solutions with JS and React framework;
  • Participate in the complete cycle of development from requirements gathering, development and testing;
  • Participate in technical discussions with international customer on a daily basis;
  • Code development;
  • Be part of a team modernizing apps and implementing new features.


Essential Skills

  • Experience as a Javascript frontend developer using the React framework;
  • Advanced knowledge of HTML, CSS for crafting responsive and interactive user interfaces;
  • Experience working in an agile development environment with User Experience (UX)/Service Designer teams, Software Developers, and Scrum Masters to iteratively create or improve digital products and services from conception to production.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Angular (2.x) framework;
  • Backend development with .NET/C#.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

As a Frontend React Developer, you will contribute to the team's user experience, application performance, and front-end architecture. This requires applying strong debugging and problem-solving skills to technical challenges and maintaining clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role is responsible for promoting secure coding practices, delivering high-quality solutions, and helping to shape team standards. You will utilize cloud platform capabilities, particularly AWS, while working independently to manage priorities and collaborating with backend, DevOps, and architecture teams to support the team's commitment to continuous improvement.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Work in a dynamic team to provide solutions with JS and React framework;
  • Participate in the complete cycle of development from requirements gathering, development and testing;
  • Participate in technical discussions with international customer on a daily basis;
  • Code development;
  • Be part of a team modernizing apps and implementing new features.


Essential Skills

  • Experience as a Javascript frontend developer using the React framework;
  • Advanced knowledge of HTML, CSS for crafting responsive and interactive user interfaces;
  • Experience working in an agile development environment with User Experience (UX)/Service Designer teams, Software Developers, and Scrum Masters to iteratively create or improve digital products and services from conception to production.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Angular (2.x) framework;
  • Backend development with .NET/C#.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Google & YouTube Ads Growth Strategist – eCommerce Scaling Expert
description:
About Ad-Lab:

Ad-Lab is not your average performance marketing agency — we’re an elite e-commerce scaling engine. We’ve managed $150M+ in ad spend, scaled 100+ brands, and built a culture of high-performance and fast execution.

We’re looking for a Google & YouTube Ads Growth Strategist who’s already operated at the top 1% level — someone who’s scaled multiple e-commerce brands from $10k/month to $100k-$500k+ in ad spend, built and tested full-funnel strategies (PMAX, Shopping, YouTube, Search), and understands how to build, test, and scale cold traffic. You’re not here to manage — you’re here to make noise, break limits, and lead client success.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Develop & execute full-funnel strategies across Google Ads & YouTube for fast-growing DTC brands.
  • Lead account audits, scaling roadmaps, and creative testing cycles.
  • Scale PMAX and YouTube campaigns, optimize Shopping & Search, and unlock cold traffic profitability.
  • Guide clients on ad creative (scripts, angles, formats), funnel structure, CRO, and landing page strategy.
  • Direct landing page & advertorial builds (listicles, quizzes, VSLs).
  • Provide weekly performance reviews, client education, and action plans.


You’re a Fit If You:

  • Have scaled brands from $10k/month to $100k-$500k+ spend levels while maintaining ROAS.
  • Have hands-on experience managing $1M+/month in Google/YouTube ad spend.
  • Have built successful YouTube campaigns and know how to test hooks, CTAs, and audiences.
  • Are deeply analytical, fast-moving, and thrive on performance-based environments.
  • Know how to communicate with DTC founders, speak their language, and lead strategic direction.
  • Have worked in or alongside high-level CRO & creative testing environments.

title: Saas Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Software Architect .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Senior Python Software Engineer (AI)
description:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.


At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.


Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, skilled in Python and with experience developing solutions with LLMs to work as a Consultant out of our Brazilian Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we scale up our AI Services and onboard new and exciting clients in this sector. 


A successful candidate in this role will be self-motivated and responsible for the full product lifecycle, from architecting scalable systems to rapid prototyping and experimentation. If you are passionate about building robust, high-quality systems and want to make a significant impact on an innovative product, this role is for you. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build : Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP that serve as the backbone for our AI-powered products.
  • Develop AI Solutions: Implement and optimize sophisticated AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, to solve complex client problems.
  • Innovate & Experiment: Rapidly prototype and experiment with cutting-edge LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and tool integration.
  • Champion Code Quality: Take ownership of the development lifecycle and champion best practices for writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Collaborate & Lead: Work closely with product, data, and business stakeholders to shape the AI product roadmap and provide technical leadership.


Must Have Skills: 

  • Expert-Level Python: 3+ years of professional experience with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python and its ecosystem for building robust APIs and data-driven applications.
  • Production Cloud Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP. You are comfortable with core services like Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, EC2/Compute Engine, etc.
  • Hands-On AI Experience: You have built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or application, demonstrating your ability to translate AI concepts into real-world solutions.
  • Engineering Excellence: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, writes
  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.


Nice to Have Skills: 

  • Applied AI Development: Hands-on experience developing solutions with LLMs (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs) and/or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK).
  • AI Infrastructure: Familiarity with services like AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and semantic search concepts.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • Salary Range from 3,443 - 4,120 USD/mo  
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only ), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the Role:

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and API-based applications. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to design and execute test strategies that support modern engineering practices and high-quality software delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with strong automation expertise, a deep understanding of quality engineering, and the ability to collaborate effectively in distributed Agile teams.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using Selenium WebDriver .
  • Create and maintain automated tests for RESTful APIs, including validation of headers, payloads, and data structures.
  • Develop and support test frameworks using Java , Cucumber , and Maven .
  • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines within Jenkins , integrating version control and build tools.
  • Validate data integrity through SQL queries and support backend testing.
  • Troubleshoot issues by analyzing logs, debugging test failures, and collaborating closely with development teams.
  • Work with JIRA for requirement management and defect tracking, and Confluence for documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, collaborate across global teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience with Selenium , including locators, waits, and driver configuration.
  • Strong experience in REST API testing, including JSON/XML validation, HTTP verbs, Postman, and Swagger.
  • Good experience with Java , including control structures, exception handling, and database queries.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, including DML, joins, and basic schema definitions.
  • Good experience with Jenkins , including job configuration and integrating Git/SVN and Maven.
  • Hands-on experience with Cucumber , including writing feature files and step definitions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work with distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of software testing best practices, debugging techniques, and problem-solving.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Allure reporting.
  • Background in test strategy definition or QA process improvements.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices or willingness to learn.
  • Experience in highly collaborative, fast-paced environments.

title: Front End Engineer (Sanity)
description:
Join Our Client as a Front End Engineer (Sanity)

About the Organisation


Our Client operates within the digital technology space, delivering innovative solutions that shape the future of online experiences. Renowned for their collaborative culture and commitment to growth, they foster a dynamic environment where creativity and technical excellence thrive. Recognised for leading-edge projects and a supportive community, it's an excellent place to develop your career and make a meaningful impact.
Role Overview
 Due to an exciting expansion driven by strategic initiatives, our Client is seeking a talented Front End Engineer with expertise in SanityCMS. This role is key to enhancing their digital presence and delivering seamless user experiences. It offers a unique chance to embed yourself in innovative projects that influence global digital platforms. If you are passionate about modern front-end development and eager to push boundaries, this opportunity is perfect for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain responsive, accessible web interfaces using React and TypeScript, aligning with best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate design concepts into functional web components.
  • Integrate and optimise SanityCMS to ensure content management is efficient and user-friendly.
  • Write clean, maintainable code in HTML, CSS, and TS, ensuring optimal performance across browsers and devices.
  • Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and refining performance to uphold high-quality standards.
  • Contribute to continual improvement of development processes and technical documentation.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience building front-end applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5/CSS3 for crafting responsive and accessible layouts.
  • Hands-on experience with SanityCMS or similar headless CMS solutions.
  • Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within a team and follow clear technical guidance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and quality.


Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Additional experience with other JavaScript frameworks or libraries.
  • Knowledge of build tools and package managers like Webpack, npm, or Yarn.
  • Understanding of SEO best practices and performance optimisation techniques.
  • Experience with agile development methodologies.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX principles and graphic design tools.


Ready to Make an Impact?


If you are excited by the prospect of developing cutting-edge digital experiences and meet the essential criteria, we encourage you to submit your CV today. Join our Client's journey to innovate and shape the future of online content delivery.

title: Tech Lead .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa .

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD , testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento .

- Boa comunicação , com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: SAP Integration Lead (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP Integration Lead

We are looking for a consultant able to lead integration processes accross all levels of our client's environment, in contact with stakeholders and also with outside partners.

Together with the leading skills and understanding of the business, the ideal profile would have a strong technical background in SAP SD; SAP ABAP; SAP Order-to-Cash and EDI & Idoc Integration.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Provide solution architect leadership & strategy development.
  • Lead Technical architect for medium to large projects.
  • Accountable across multiple functional and technical areas with wide range of complexity.
  • Lead the overall design, including the structure of a segment solution based on requirements from the business, global and regional views, as well as the design of standard software configurations.
  • Building delivery blueprints including but not limited to application diagrams, physical architecture, process diagrams, systems maps, service interfaces, technical interfaces, data modeling, integration planning.
  • Translates non-functional and functional requirement into solution designs, ensuring solution aligns with business goals and processes, uses and provides enterprise information consistently, integrates effectively with other applications, supports a common application environment and user interaction model, uses the common technology platform, and achieves enterprise level security, quality of service and scale.
  • Collaborates with Enterprise Architecture to make sure that the solution fits within enterprise context, while also ensures solutions align with business goals and processes, and follow client's IT Standards and Best Practices.
  • Participates in client's Community of Practice forum with other Solution Architects.
  • Coordinates complex solution architecture implementations while leading design variances based upon business needs. Ensures artifacts are documented.
  • Coordinates engagements with internal and external parties as they relate to evaluation, design and delivery of business capabilities.
  • Contributes to the evaluation and selection of software product standards.
  • Participant in industry representation, policy formation, User Groups, and strategic direction.
  • Provides coaching and leadership to system software developers through enhancements and projects.
  • Works well with varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Able to communicate technical information in a non-technical manner to Business team (written and verbal).
  • Able to understand business requirements to turn into technical specification solutions.
  • Stay abreast of latest technologies in his/her functional space, consistently growing in knowledge and industry trends.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 10 years IT professional work experience.
  • Mandatory to have excellent fluency in English; both written and verbal communication skills.
  • Candidate will be regarded as SME and should have high level of expertise in SAP - SD component.
  • Strong ABAP skills, with complex troubleshooting experience.
  • SAP Order-to-Cash end to end expertise required (SD).
  • EDI and Idoc experience highly preferred.
  • Experience in software engineering, software development, solution architecture and able to develop a High Level Design (HLD) and ideally with ability to deliver Low Level Designs within area of expertise.
  • Experience in highly integrated complex data environments e.g. EDI/ BI/ ETL, ERP etc, and open to working in a multitude of SAP and NonSAP applications and technologies.
  • Candidate should possess high level of consultative skills and have prior experience of collaborating with Business Analysts and Enterprise Architects in solving complex business problems with innovative technical solutions.
  • Strong leadership skills
  • Creative thinking
  • Self-motivated and self-starting on work
  • Strong Technical leadership of Application Development teams and vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with Enterprise Architects and infrastructure engineers to identify, design, and implement highly complex, end-to-end solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC processes and methodologies
  • Excellent collaboration skills and can quickly cultivate networking opportunities within the organization at varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Broad range of business and IT experiences
  • Hold technical and/or business certification(s).
  • Ability to work in a virtual team across distance, with different cultures and time zones, in a matrix with multiple reporting lines, with on-shore and off-shore resources (may extend outside the organization including suppliers, partners and customers).


We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech
HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.
To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.
About the Role
As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.
Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required. What You’ll Gain
Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Copywriter Sênior
description:
Você será o/a responsável por criar um departamento do absoluto zero, focado exclusivamente em reduzir o CPL do Pobre, enquanto atrai usuários cada vez mais qualificados para a audiência usando o tráfego pago. Buscamos um perfil sênior. Alguém pronto, intuitivo, experiente e estratégico.


Responsabilidades:

  • Você deve ser capaz de desenvolver processos ultra-simplificados, criar e liderar ideias, orientar o time de conteúdo e, acima de tudo, não se limitar à execução de demandas, mas sim o responsável por uma direção estratégica própria.
  • Na maior parte do tempo, o seu trabalho será de criação. Você terá à disposição um influenciador 100% focado na marca, dedicado integralmente às produções e disponível para gravações, testes, validações de conteúdo, roteiros, ideias e novos formatos.
  • Você também poderá guiar atores, UGCs, influenciadores e colaboradores na produção de conteúdos estratégicos voltados ao Pobre.
  • Conforme as demandas crescerem ou surgirem necessidades estratégicas, o seu time será ampliado. Você terá autonomia para indicar novos profissionais, desde que atendam aos padrões da marca.
  • É parte do seu trabalho não apenas reduzir o custo de expansão da audiência, mas conseguir qualificar leads das mais diferentes classes sociais, tornando a comunicação mais ativa, consistente e valiosa.
  • É seu dever manter uma comunicação clara, direta e respeitosa, contribuindo com insights estratégicos para capacitar não apenas o seu departamento, mas também o time de produto.


Requisitos:

  • O grande desafio deste processo seletivo é entender se você realmente sabe qual é o direcionamento criativo adequado para a marca do Pobre. Buscamos alguém que já compreenda todas as implicações decorrentes do nome e do tom característico da marca. Alguém que não precisa de explicações óbvias para captar a essência do Pobre e transformá-la em conteúdo de alto impacto.
  • Se você olha para uma marca chamada “Promoções para Pobres” e o seu lado creator não borbulha, este é um importante sinal de que aqui talvez não seja lugar para você.
  • Você precisa compreender que o Pobre jamais será uma marca tradicional. Você terá um grande desafio criativo, precisará estar sempre atualizado. Ser veloz, flexível e saber navegar por tendências é essencial.
  • Se você não se considera cronicamente online, não faz ideia do que é um shitpost, jamais foi heavy user de Twitter/X e é desconectado desses mundos, essa vaga provavelmente não é para você.
  • Organização, autogestão e compromisso com prazos e entregas são inegociáveis. Esperamos maturidade e responsabilidade profissional.
  • Aqui é um lugar de paz. Desenvolver e liderar as equipes, deve ser um processo natural, sempre se comunicando de maneira eficiente, humana e respeitosa.
  • Você precisa entender técnicas avançadas de copywriting, gatilhos mentais e storytelling.
  • Portfólio, formação superior ou domínio de língua estrangeira (especialmente inglês) são bem-vindos, mas não são critérios eliminatórios.


Da Remuneração e Contratação:

  • Modelo de contratação PJ.
  • Salário a combinar, compatível com a senioridade e o aumento de responsabilidade do cargo.
  • Metas, incentivos e bônus de performance podem ser combinados.
  • A vaga não exige a criação e otimização de anúncios.

title: Analista de rede
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX); criação e manutenção de SSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC; criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 07 às 19h


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior - Python/React
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A vaga é para uma empresa recém adquirida pelo iFood, eles possuem uma plataforma tecnológica voltada ao setor de food service, que digitaliza e automatiza toda a operação de restaurantes. Oferece módulos como cardápio digital, gestão de pedidos, delivery e relatórios analíticos. A solução é integrada, funciona mesmo offline e atende desde pequenos negócios até grandes redes.



Sobre o Papel

Como Desenvolvedor FullStack Sênior - Python e React, você será responsável por:


Responsabilidades

  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de aplicações web de ponta utilizando as tecnologias Python e React;
  • Trabalhar em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a concepção da aplicação até a sua implantação;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de Produto e Design para traduzir requisitos em soluções técnicas eficientes;
  • Escrever código de alta qualidade, bem documentado e testado;
  • Identificar e implementar melhorias constantes nos processos e na arquitetura da aplicação;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e dar suporte técnico à equipe, sempre buscando o crescimento coletivo.



Habilidades Necessárias

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python e suas principais bibliotecas (Django, Flask, etc.);
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de aplicações web com React.js;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacionais (SQL) e não relacionais (NoSQL);
  • Habilidade em desenvolver APIs RESTful e trabalhar com arquiteturas orientadas a microserviços;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git) e metodologias ágeis;
  • Bom entendimento de conceitos de infraestrutura e implantação de aplicações (containerização, CI/CD, etc.);
  • Comunicação eficaz, proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.


Contratação CLT com benefícios padrões de mercado.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Role: Operations Manager (Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics: We are only considering candidates with experience in the Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry. Please apply only if you have worked in this field.

Contract: Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate: $12.50 - $18 USD hourly / $2,000 - $2,880 monthly (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start: Immediately


Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.


What You'll Do

As the Operations Manager, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth, and collaborative improvement. As the Operations Manager, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don't need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include:


Operations & Integrator Coordination: 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.


System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.


Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.


Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.


Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.


What You Should Have

Must-haves:

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Salon, Spa, Aesthetic, or Wellness brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling/inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.


Technology Specifications:

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.


Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who:

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what's not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.
